id: title:Gilbert09:always query report tables on segments date

review.posthog_relevance: Google Ads warehouse connector reliability and query correctness
review.reason: The production code change in P1.F2.H2 unconditionally sets the incremental field to `segments.date` when a report table requires a filter, regardless of prior configuration. This prevents the warehouse connector from sending an invalid field name to Google Ads, which could cause connector failure or incorrect results. This is a substantive, bounded correctness and reliability fix.
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the complete implementation or full test coverage of the Google Ads warehouse connector, so the broader systemic impact and complete validation are not fully demonstrated. The benefit is inferred from the code change rather than observed end-to-end behavior.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the complete implementation of the Google Ads warehouse connector. While P1.F1.H1 shows the production code change and P1.F2.H1 and P1.F2.H2 show the corresponding test changes, the chunk does not include the full context of the Google Ads connector implementation, the complete Google Ads warehouse connector, or the complete Google Ads warehouse tests.
